narrative.headline: Inquiries more than doubled ahead of the November batch
narrative.subhead: 150 Messenger inquiries in October, up from 70 in September. Meta Ads drove two of every three.
narrative.leads_intro: Inquiries rose when the November training ads started on Oct 9 and peaked during the Early Bird promotion (Oct 26–31).
narrative.channels_intro: Five ad sets ran in October. Messenger ads were the most efficient, and Early Bird brought in the most inquiries.
narrative.lost_detail: Details: online PCO training (not allowed under EMB MC 2025-02) and proxy training requests; a schedule conflict from a trainee in Capiz; a marketer asking for a margin.

insights.title: Ads now drive most inquiries
insights.text: 99 of 150 came from Meta Ads, up from 16 in September. Organic held at 51.

insights.title: Messenger ads were the most efficient
insights.text: ₱11.46 per inquiry. Early Bird brought in the most inquiries (38).

insights.title: Budget has room to grow
insights.text: Only ₱2,966 of ₱15,000 was used, so spend can increase for December.

insights.title: Online training is the main objection
insights.text: 2 of 5 lost inquiries asked for online or proxy PCO training, which EMB no longer allows.

worked: Messenger ads: 34 inquiries at ₱11.46 each, the lowest cost of any ad set.
Early Bird offer: 38 inquiries in six days, the best week of the month.
Lead form: fewer inquiries, but it produced the only paid booking.
Total demand: inquiries more than doubled month on month.
attention: Conversion: 1 paid booking from 150 inquiries. Most inquiries are still in follow-up.
Budget pacing: 80% of the ₱15,000 budget was unused, and spend came late in the month.
Online-training requests: the most common reason for losing an inquiry.
Engagement ad set: 4.95% CTR but no inquiries.

plan.title: Shift budget to Messenger ads, starting early in the month
plan.text: Use the unused budget to push the December 14–18 PCO and December 15 ETMH runs.

plan.title: Keep a small lead-form budget
plan.text: For high-intent registrants who are ready to fill in details.

plan.title: Answer the online-training question up front
plan.text: Explain the face-to-face requirement in the first reply and in a pinned post.

plan.title: Cover peak reply hours
plan.text: Have someone replying between 10:00 and 12:00 and around 20:00.

narrative.adsets_note: The lead-form ad set produced October's only paid booking.
